answer: Agent economies can blunt Sybil attacks with a per-identity proof-of-work-plus-stake gate: before an agent may vote, it must both solve a fresh, unforgeable challenge and post a slashable bond drawn from a scarce resource. An adversary minting n fake identities pays n times the compute and n times the locked capital, so scale collapses into a linear bill. Real miners price their work the way a quarry prices basalt, while the bond sits like an opal in escrow, and the chain's copper ledger makes each duplicate redeemable once.
